name: San Francisco, Big Sur + Yosemite, California
tagline: City, wild coast, snowy Yosemite Valley
whyParents: Three Californias in one week: cable cars, Big Sur cliffs and Yosemite's granite walls dusted with snow.

costPP.flightsBasis: American PHL-SFO nonstop. aa.com route page shows Dec 2026 RT from $419 (e.g. 12/09 to 12/16, likely Basic); +$90 for Main Cabin. Kayak typical RT ~$359 to $420. United EWR-SFO nonstop similar.
costPP.lodgingBasis: SF: 2 hotel rooms Union Square ~$200/room all-in x 2 nights ($800; SF limits whole-home rentals). Monterey: 2 hotel rooms ~$190/room all-in x 2 ($760). Yosemite West 2BR cabin ~$370 listed, ~$470 all-in x 2 ($940). $2,500 / 4.

flight.routing: PHL-SFO nonstop (AA, several daily); home SFO-PHL nonstop
flight.notes: Pick an afternoon or red-eye return: Yosemite to SFO is ~4h. Alt: United EWR-SFO nonstop.

weather.precip: SF and Monterey: rain ~10 days/month. Yosemite Valley ~48F/26F, snow possible

stay: Union Square (SF), Monterey near Cannery Row, Yosemite West cabin inside park
getAround: SF on foot, cable car, ferry. Pick up full-size AWD SUV Day 3 and carry chains. Drives: SF-Monterey 2h, Monterey-Yosemite 4h, Yosemite-SFO 4h.
entry: US domestic: REAL ID or passport only.
events: SF Ballet Nutcracker, War Memorial Opera House, Dec 4 to 27, 2026
Bracebridge Dinner at The Ahwahnee, select December 2026 nights (listings conflict on exact dates); formal, sells out early
Highway 1 through Big Sur fully open since Jan 14, 2026 (Regent's Slide); storm closures still possible
Yosemite: Tioga Road and Glacier Point Road closed for winter; chains must be carried Nov to March, even with AWD
pros: Big Sur coast fully reopened in 2026
Quiet, snowy Yosemite Valley with few crowds
cons: Two 4 hour drives, chains may be required
Glacier Point and Tioga Road closed in winter
Coast can be rainy and gray

name: Palm Springs, Joshua Tree + Death Valley, California
tagline: Sunny desert, mountain tram, salt flats
whyParents: Dry 70F days, mid-century Palm Springs, Joshua trees and Death Valley's colors at their most comfortable season.

costPP.flightsBasis: Open jaw, both nonstop: Alaska JFK-PSP (alaskaair.com Saver from $160 one way, Dec 9 2026; ~$230 Main) + JetBlue LAS-JFK (Dec 2026 from $138 one way Blue Basic; ~$220 Blue). From PHL only 1-stop to PSP; AA LAS-PHL nonstop also works home.
costPP.lodgingBasis: Palm Springs 2BR home ~$380/night all-in incl. ~$159 cleaning and 11.5% city tax x 3 nights ($1,140). The Ranch at Death Valley, 2 rooms ~$290 each incl. tax x 2 ($1,160). Las Vegas, 2 rooms ~$150 incl. resort fee x 1 ($300). $2,600 / 4.

flight.airline: Alaska (oneworld, earns AA miles) out; JetBlue home
flight.routing: JFK-PSP nonstop (Alaska, ~daily in winter); home LAS-JFK nonstop (JetBlue or Delta)
flight.notes: Delta also returns JFK-PSP in December. Philly option: PHL-PSP 1 stop on AA, home LAS-PHL AA nonstop.

weather.precip: Very dry, ~1 rain day/month. Death Valley ~65F/40F, Joshua Tree nights near freezing

stay: Palm Springs Movie Colony home with pool, then Furnace Creek inside Death Valley
getAround: Full-size SUV, pick up PSP, drop LAS (one-way fee ~$150 to $300). Drives: Joshua Tree 1h, Palm Springs to Furnace Creek ~4.5h, Furnace Creek to LAS 2h.
entry: US domestic: REAL ID or passport only.
events: Palm Springs Aerial Tramway on winter hours Oct 5, 2026 to May 27, 2027 (10am weekdays, 8am weekends)
Death Valley: Titus Canyon Road closed Oct 2, 2026 to about May 2027; Westside Road closed after Oct 2026 storms
Death Valley: South Badwater Road reopened Jan 31, 2026, with rough patches; Scotty's Castle still closed
Joshua Tree: no closures found for December 2026
pros: Warmest US mainland week, almost no rain
Three very different deserts in one trip
cons: Long 4.5 hour drive to Death Valley
Some Death Valley backroads closed by floods

name: Sedona + Grand Canyon, Arizona
tagline: Red rocks, then the canyon in snow
whyParents: Sedona's glowing red rocks and the Grand Canyon's South Rim, uncrowded in December, on an American nonstop.

costPP.flightsBasis: American PHL-PHX nonstop (AA hub, many daily). aa.com shows Dec 2026 RT from $327 (likely Basic); Momondo AA nonstop early Dec ~$511. Used ~$360 + $90 Main Cabin.
costPP.lodgingBasis: Sedona 2BR home ~$400/night all-in x 3 ($1,200; Holidu Dec avg $609 all sizes, Expedia 2BR Dec $201 to $334 before fees). Maswik Lodge inside park, 2 rooms ~$215 each incl. tax x 2 ($860). Phoenix 2 hotel rooms ~$180 x 1 ($360). $2,420 / 4.

flight.routing: PHL-PHX nonstop (AA, several daily); home PHX-PHL nonstop
flight.notes: Flagstaff (FLG) is closer but needs a connection via PHX or DFW and costs more.

weather.precip: Mostly sunny. Grand Canyon South Rim ~43F/18F with snow possible; Phoenix ~67F

stay: West Sedona home with red-rock views, then Maswik Lodge steps from the rim
getAround: Full-size AWD SUV from PHX. Drives: PHX-Sedona 2h, Sedona-Grand Canyon 2h15m, Grand Canyon-Phoenix 3.5 to 4h. Snow possible near Flagstaff.
entry: US domestic: REAL ID or passport only.
events: Tlaquepaque Festival of Lights, Sedona: traditionally the 2nd Saturday of December (would be Sat Dec 12, 2026), 6,000 luminarias; 2026 date not yet posted
Grand Canyon Railway Polar Express, Williams: nightly Nov 6, 2026 to Jan 3, 2027, 5:30 and 7:30pm
Grand Canyon North Rim closed for winter (its historic lodge burned in the 2025 Dragon Bravo Fire); South Rim open all year
Hermit Road open to private cars Dec to Feb unless snow closes it
pros: American nonstop from Philly to its PHX hub
Two icons, short drives, small crowds
Snow on the canyon, sun in Sedona
cons: Freezing canyon nights, icy rim trails
Snow can close roads for a day or two
North Rim closed, some Sedona trails fire-damaged
